summary: Brookfield Wealth Solutions Ltd. (BWS) filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing board approval for a corporate simplification transaction. Under the plan, all class A shares of BN and BWS will be exchanged one-for-one for new shares of Brookfield Corporation Ltd., creating a single publicly traded entity listed on NYSE and TSX under symbol BN. The transaction, structured as a court-approved plan of arrangement, is expected to close by year-end 2026 subject to shareholder approval at annual meetings on July 16, 2026, and regulatory approvals. The exchange is proposed to be tax-deferred for U.S. and Canadian shareholders. Post-closing, the combined entity will pay a quarterly distribution equal to current BN and BWS distributions. This is a corporate restructuring/amalgamation, not a standard acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer, with no premium or price-per-share explicitly stated. What to watch: shareholder vote outcomes and regulatory approvals; risk-arb spread will be minimal as it's a 1:1 exchange of affiliated entities.
